context: Gale’s in‑party dialog is a catch‑all conversation set that fires whenever you speak to him in the game world and reacts to a variety of events involving him or other companions. The provided examples illustrate one branch where Gale confronts Astarion about being a vampire if you reach Act II without Astarion having revealed it (or without a night bite/camp reveal), noting clues like walking in daylight and the parasite that grants immunity. In that branch Gale is gently reproachful—he won’t let the player/companion deny it and asks why they weren’t honest, while the player can respond defensively or conciliatory. Other clustered contexts show Gale also comments on romance, item finds, confessions (e.g., Dark Urge), and similar events; the samples are illustrative, not exhaustive.
